title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors surrounding Bentley University, from the vibrant dining scene on Moody Street to the convenient retail hubs along Lexington Street.

cards.title: The Dining Corridor
cards.subtitle: Moody Street, Waltham
cards.notes: Walk this vibrant stretch to find diverse international cuisine and local favorites like Bison County, serving as the primary social hub for off-campus student dining.
cards.short_summary: Waltham's primary dining and social district located south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Moody Street is described as the 'hot spot for foodies' and a vibrant social scene for Bentley students, featuring restaurants like Bison County and Margaritas.
cards.source_title: 39 Places That Prove Waltham Has Everything You Need - Bentley University
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Bentley shuttle or a short drive; most businesses are open daily until 9:00 PM or later.

cards.title: The Essentials Block
cards.subtitle: Lexington Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this retail block for daily necessities at Star Market and quick bites at Panera Bread or Chipotle, conveniently located just north of the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A major shopping center on Lexington Street providing student essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: Waltham Plaza at 1074 Lexington Street features Star Market, Panera Bread, and Chipotle, serving as a local stop for everyday essentials.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; Star Market typically operates 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: The Civic Heart
cards.subtitle: Main Street at Elm Street
cards.notes: Attend seasonal community festivals or enjoy the open green space at this central park, which serves as the anchor for Waltham's historic downtown district.
cards.short_summary: A central public park and gathering space in downtown Waltham.
cards.evidence_claim: Waltham Common is a recognized place near Bentley University used for community events and public transit connections.
cards.source_title: How to Get to Bentley University in Waltham by Bus, Train or Subway?
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: The Campus Connector
cards.subtitle: Beaver Street Corridor
cards.notes: Travel this scenic route connecting the main campus to the Lyman Estate and local recreation areas, passing through the historic DeVincent Farm area.
cards.short_summary: A key thoroughfare bordering the southern edge of Bentley's campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Beaver Street proceeds eastward past Forest Street and Bentley University, connecting Lexington Street to the Lyman Estate area.
cards.access_notes: Public roadway with sidewalks; provides access to Bentley's Lewis Lot.

cards.title: The Recreation Block
cards.subtitle: Trapelo Road Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this newly developed 120-acre recreation area for walking paths, adult fitness stations, and open field space just north of the university.
cards.short_summary: A large municipal recreation area on Trapelo Road near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Waltham opened a 120-acre recreation area at 200 Trapelo Road in 2025, featuring walking paths and fitness areas.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 days a week from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM; no street parking allowed.

cards.title: The Skyline View
cards.subtitle: Totten Pond Road
cards.notes: Hike the trails at this park to reach one of the highest points in the region, offering panoramic views of the Boston skyline and surrounding suburbs.
cards.short_summary: A major wooded park on Totten Pond Road known for its hiking and views.
cards.evidence_claim: Prospect Hill Park at 314 Totten Pond Road is a primary location for outdoor recreation and city-run programs.
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily; main entrance is located on Totten Pond Road.

cards.title: The Student Residential Block
cards.subtitle: Linden Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this corridor known for off-campus student housing options and its proximity to the shops and restaurants of Main Street.
cards.short_summary: A residential street popular for off-campus student apartments.
cards.evidence_claim: Linden Street is noted for having housing options near Bentley University and is located about a mile from the Main Street downtown district.
cards.source_title: Linden Street Apartments - 99-109 Linden St Waltham, MA 02452
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; parking may be restricted to residents with permits.

cards.title: The Retail Hub
cards.subtitle: Lexington Street at Lakeview
cards.notes: Shop for apparel and home goods at T.J. Maxx or find unique gifts at The Paper Store in this busy retail hub north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A retail center on Lexington Street featuring national brands.
cards.evidence_claim: Wal-Lex Shopping Center at 850 Lexington Street includes T.J. Maxx and The Paper Store, serving as a retail hub in Waltham.
cards.source_title: Discover the Vibrant Wal-Lex Shopping Center - Evendo
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typical hours are 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM Monday through Saturday.

cards.title: The Fitness Corridor
cards.subtitle: Route 60 Corridor
cards.notes: Find specialized fitness facilities like the Waverley Oaks Athletic Club and local eateries along this road connecting Waltham to Belmont.
cards.short_summary: A commercial and fitness-oriented corridor east of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Waverley Oaks Road (Route 60) features businesses like the Waverley Oaks Athletic Club and City Streets Restaurant.
cards.source_title: Businesses in Waltham, MA - Enigma Data
cards.access_notes: Public roadway; businesses have varying hours.

cards.title: The Academic Link
cards.subtitle: Forest Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this primary campus thoroughfare to reach the North Campus residential buildings and the main university entrance from Trapelo Road.
cards.short_summary: The main street running through and connecting Bentley's campus areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Forest Street is the location of the main Bentley campus entrance and connects to the North Campus residential buildings.
cards.access_notes: Public street with university shuttle stops and pedestrian sidewalks.
